workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where both are free next week:

- Monday: 9:00-9:30 or 9:30-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, or 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-15:30 or 15:30-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30

Could you check Elena and David's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them? Or if you find other overlapping times for Elena and David, let me know those too.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked Elena and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you identified work for both of them. Here's my analysis of each slot:

Monday 9:00-9:30: Elena busy (Contract review), David busy (Quarterly planning)
Monday 9:30-10:00: Elena busy (Recruiting call), David busy (Recruiting call)
Tuesday 13:00-13:30: Elena busy (Quarterly planning), David busy (Client call)
Tuesday 13:30-14:00: Elena busy (Contract review), David busy
Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David busy (Travel)
Wednesday 15:00-15:30: Elena free, but David busy (Partner lunch)
Wednesday 15:30-16:00: Elena busy (Budget review), David busy
Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David free
Friday 11:00-11:30: Elena busy (Client dinner prep), David busy (Training session)
Friday 11:30-12:00: Elena busy (1:1 with associate), David busy (Litigation strategy)

The times when BOTH Elena and David are free are:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 9:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 9:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

None of these overlap with your slots. Could you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if they might be free during any of Elena+David's free times above? If not, it appears we cannot schedule this meeting next week.
